## Circular to Licensed Corporations and Associated Entities

## Forms specified by SFC

For the purpose of compliance with the requirements under sections 145 and 156(1)(a) of the Securities and Futures Ordinance ('SFO') as amplified in section 56 of the Securities and  Futures  (Financial  Resources)  Rules  and  sections  3(1)  &amp;  (3)  of  the  Securities  and Futures  (Accounts  and  Audit)  Rules  respectively,  the  SFC  has  developed  the  following forms:-

## Form under the Securities and Futures (Financial Resources) Rules

1. Financial Return

## Forms under the Securities and Futures (Accounts and Audit) Rules

2. Business and Risk Management Questionnaire for Licensed Corporation
3. Business and Risk Management Questionnaire for Associated Entity
4. Account Disclosure Document for Licensed Corporation
5. Analysis of Client Assets for Associated Entity

The  above  forms  are  now  available  for  collection  at  the  SFC's  office  and  can  be downloaded from the SFC's website at http://www.hksfc.org.hk (under Bills, Legislation &amp; Codes =&gt; Securities and Futures Ordinance =&gt; Forms specified by the Commission =&gt; Financial return and forms under S&amp;F (Accounts and Audit) Rules).

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Ms. Cecilia Kan on 2842 7780.
